7057.title: Composer visible-height overflow
7057.rootCauseOneLine: The shared editor cap uses dynamic viewport units while the mobile shell tracks visualViewport.height; thread composers have no host-provided available-height cap.
7057.proposedFix: Use visualViewport.height for the shared editor's existing fractional viewport caps, keeping host bounds and dvh fallback.
7057.caveats: Actual app reproduced twice with a simulated visual-viewport resize; no native iOS keyboard or message-edit UI verification.
